notes:
Pet Calculator — a new page that does the livestock sums for you.

Pick a beast (Boar, Wolf, Lox, Hen or Asksvin) and it lays out the taming clock, the food you need to carry, the breeding density cap and how long a herd takes to fill the pen. The pen designer takes octagonal, rectangular or square paddocks, sizes them with sliders, and prices the walls piece by piece.

Wall catalogue covers Wood (wall, half, quarter, log beams, stakewall), Ashwood, Stone 1x1 / 2x1 / 4x2, Grausten 1x2 / 2x2 / 4x2, Black Marble tiles 1x1 / 2x2 / 2x4, Iron cage walls, Crystal and Dvergr — each with its live recipe, a cost per square metre so you can spot the efficient piece, and a gate or door of your choosing.

Every wall piece, food and drop links straight through to its Valheim Data page, and the costs read from the live data set, so a data refresh keeps the calculator honest. Yield cards use the real chance-weighted drop tables.

The sidebar nav now scrolls on its own, with the profile, sync and Launch footer pinned in place.
